title: Creamy Pesto Pasta with Cottage Cheese
description: A silky herb pasta sauce powered by blended cottage cheese instead of cream, ready in under 30 minutes.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese with a splash of water until smooth.
Blitz the garlic, basil, parmesan, oil, lemon juice and seasoning into a pesto.
Cook the pasta, then stir through the pesto and cottage cheese off the heat.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste creamy pesto pasta with cottage cheese

notes: Cottage cheese saves roughly 200 calories versus a cream-based sauce while keeping the protein where it needs to be.
